fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) declined 21% over one month, Nvidia (NVDA) fell 40%, but AMD's Q3 data center revenue increased 97%, projecting 80%+ sales growth in 2027 and server CPU TAM growth of 50%+ CAGR through 2030.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite CEO misconduct, Nvidia delivered Q3 revenue of $115.8B (exceeding consensus of $109B) and EPS of $2.68 (exceeding expectations of $2.47), demonstrating robust AI infrastructure demand, and provided 2028 annual growth guidance of 75%.
